set: GK Drill 6: Mixed 2026: economy, science, people, world

sections.name: GK drill: Mixed 2026: economy, science, people, world

questions.q: Where was the 18th BRICS Summit held in September 2026?
questions.why: 12–13 September 2026, adopting the New Delhi Declaration.

questions.q: The 2026 SCO Heads of State summit was hosted by:
questions.why: Tianjin hosted in 2025.

questions.q: Which law replaced MGNREGA in 2026, guaranteeing 125 days of rural work?
questions.why: Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin).

questions.q: India's real GDP growth in Q1 of FY 2026-27 was reported at:
questions.why: Released in August 2026, on the new 2022-23 base year.

questions.q: Semicon India 2026 was held in September 2026 at:
questions.why: 17–19 September 2026.

questions.q: India overtook which country in 2025 to become the world's fourth-largest economy by nominal GDP?
questions.why: Asked in the February 2026 GPSC papers.

questions.q: Who is the Governor of the Reserve Bank of India?
questions.why: The 26th Governor, since December 2024.

questions.q: UPI, which crossed 20 billion transactions in a month in 2026, is operated by:
questions.why: NPCI was set up in 2008 under RBI and IBA.

questions.q: Who became the first woman Director General of the Geological Survey of India in 2026?
questions.why: Founded in 1851, GSI is headquartered in Kolkata.

questions.q: Who is the 53rd Chief Justice of India?
questions.why: Since 24 November 2025.

questions.q: Who is the Vice-President of India (since September 2025)?
questions.why: India's 15th Vice-President.

questions.q: The Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024 (presented in 2026) went to:
questions.why: Mohanlal received the 2023 award.

questions.q: The 72nd National Film Awards were presented in September 2026 at:
questions.why: Presented by President Droupadi Murmu.

questions.q: Which company developed QDENGA, India's first approved dengue vaccine?
questions.why: Asked in the September 2026 GPSC papers.

questions.q: Which country first completed a full life-cycle harvest of rice in space?
questions.why: On the Tiangong space station, asked in 2026.

questions.q: India's indigenous public alert system used for cell broadcast warnings is called:
questions.why: Built by C-DOT for NDMA.

questions.q: Who was the first Indian astronaut to visit the International Space Station?
questions.why: Axiom-4 mission, 2025. Rakesh Sharma flew to Salyut-7 in 1984.

questions.q: 'Vikram-32', unveiled in 2025, is India's first indigenous:
questions.why: Developed by ISRO's Semi-Conductor Laboratory, Chandigarh.

questions.q: The headquarters of the New Development Bank (BRICS bank) is in:
questions.why: AIIB is in Beijing; ADB is in Manila.

questions.q: Who hosts the G20 presidency in 2026?
questions.why: South Africa held it in 2025.

questions.q: The Pithora painting tradition, which received a GI tag, belongs to:
questions.why: Painted by the Rathwa and Bhil communities.

questions.q: Joha rice, a GI-tagged aromatic rice exported in 2026, comes from:
questions.why: Asked in the March 2026 GPSC papers.

questions.q: Which national park, the site of the cheetah reintroduction, recorded a caracal in 2026?
questions.why: Madhya Pradesh.

questions.q: The PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana focuses on:
questions.why: Outlay of ₹1.44 lakh crore over six years.

questions.q: The first Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences was awarded in:
questions.why: Asked in 2026. The other Nobel Prizes began in 1901.
